description: This script interacts with GitHub's GraphQL API to fetch pull request data from the 'fastapi' repository, processes contributor and reviewer information, and updates YAML files with the top contributors, translators, and reviewres. It also automates Git operations to create a pull request with the updates.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Represents a GitHub user with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: LabelNode
classes.description: Represents a label node associated with a pull request.

classes.name: Labels
classes.description: Contains a list of label nodes.

classes.name: ReviewNode
classes.description: Represents a review on a pull request, including author and review state.

classes.name: Reviews
classes.description: Contains a list of review nodes.

classes.name: PullRequestNode
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a pull request, including labels, author, timestamps, status, and reviews.

classes.name: PullRequestEdge
classes.description: Represents an edge in the pull requests graph with cursor and node.

classes.name: PullRequests
classes.description: Contains a list of pull request edges.

classes.name: PRsRepository
classes.description: Contains pull requests fetched from a repository.

classes.name: PRsResponseData
classes.description: Contains the response data of the pull requests query.

classes.name: PRsResponse
classes.description: Defines the structure of the GraphQL response containing pull request data.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration class for GitHub token, repository, and HTTP timeout.

classes.name: ContributorsResults
classes.description: Holds counters for various contributor roles and a dictionary of authors.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_graphql_response( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: str | None = None, )
methods.description: Performs a POST request to GitHub GraphQL API, returning validated JSON data.

methods.name: list[PullRequestEdge] get_graphql_pr_edges( *, settings: Settings, after: str | None = None )
methods.description: Fetches pull request edges using the GraphQL API, handling pagination.

methods.name: list[PullRequestNode] get_pr_nodes(settings: Settings)
methods.description: Retrieves all pull request nodes by following pagination cursors.

methods.name: ContributorsResults get_contributors(pr_nodes: list[PullRequestNode])
methods.description: Analyzes pull request nodes to determine contributors, translation reviewers, and translators.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_users_to_write( *, counter: Counter[str], authors: dict[str, Author], min_count: int = 2, )
methods.description: Filters and formats users with contribution counts above a threshold.

methods.name: bool update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any)
methods.description: Reads, compares, and potentially updates a YAML content file with new data.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main orchestration function: loads config, fetches PR data, processes contributors, updates files, and manages git operations to push changes and create a pull request.
